summary: Sandbach United secured three points in their latest outing against Wedsfield CFC, with the visitors making the trip to what sounds like a competitive match. The game saw some drama late on, including a substitution mix-up that briefly left the Bach down to ten men due to new rule changes. It was a good day all round though, with Sandbach picking up the win and the opposition praised as "a lovely bunch" as they headed home.
